text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Come on, everyone! Bakushin, bakushiiin!
Five minutes until the first bell rings!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Hurry up-ssu!
The school gates are gonna close when time's up-ssu!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
...Alright, should be safe now!
City's already headed off to school today, too!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Please wait!
A shadowy figure is staggering toward us!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fwaah~... sleepy.
Mornings are such a drag, seriously...

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Ain't that Jordan!
Though you look totally dizzy and wobbly!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
No waay... Just go ahead and lock the gate~.
I'll figure something out...

Target locked on!
Gol-Gol Missile... LAUNCH!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, who was that?!
Who just kicked me?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, duh, man.
Who else could it be but me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Wouldn't you hate it more if someone else kicked ya? Imagine turning around and seeing some random old guy."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
"That may be so, but... wait, no!
Hold on, are we really okay with overlooking this?!
From a Class Rep perspective!!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Violence is absolutely out-ra-geous!
It cannot simply be overlooked!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text: However! That action was taken out of care for a friend! A beautiful friendship! A splendid solution! Thanks to that, they've made it through the gate in time!!

text_block_list.name: Bamboo Memory
text_block_list.text:
Getting injured is definitely a no-go, but...
this time you did an amazing job, ssue!!
